Alice in Disco Land. In a disco, Banner learns a dancer (Donna Wilkes) is being exploited.
Another Path. A Chinese philosopher's nerve-control techniques may help Banner; guest Mako.

Sharks attack Steve as he investigates an abandoned nuclear submarine; guests Pamela Hensley, Josh Taylor.
Sharks. Adm. Prescott orders the sub destroyed even though Steve is held aboard; guest Stephen Elliott.

Deadly Countdown. Steve learns that a friend of his was responsible for a pre-launch explosion in which Steve was injured.

Knightmares. Amnesiac Michael reverts to his old identity but must recover to save a girl's life.

The Professor. Brackett cares for an ailing foreign dignitary; the paramedics rescue a helicopter pilot, deliver a baby and prevent a suicide jump.
Syndrome. Gage diagnoses tonsillitis for DeSoto, who claims to have had his tonsils removed; McCall is reunited with an old love (Robert Alda).
Honest. Gage's and DeSoto's stands on honesty are put to the test when people who withhold vital information experience different consequences.
Seance. A woman believes her dead sister is the cause of accidents in her home; a man is trapped underwater in his car with the doors jammed.
Boot. Station 51's mascot, Boot, won't eat; accidents befall a woman attempting to cook a meal; a man nearly dies from an aspirin overdose.
Rip-Off. The paramedics conduct several rescues under a shadow of guilt after being accused of stealing from a patient; guest Jo Anne Worley.
Without Reservations. Assassins setting a trap for the attorney general hold Murdock, Frankie and wounded Face prisoner in a restaurant.
The Children of Jamestown. The rest of the team is caught while Murdock flies a girl to freedom from a religious paramilitary cult; guest John Saxon.
Pros and Cons. A boy (Meeno Peluce) whose brother (William Smith) has been unlawfully imprisoned asks his friend B.A. for help; guest Ken Norton.
A Small and Deadly War. The team investigates when a SWAT officer suspects his squad of crimes; guests Jack Ging, Dean Stockwell.
Black Day at Bad Rock. The A-Team helps a small-town sheriff fend off a vengeful motorcycle gang. With George Peppard, Dirk Benedict, Mr. T, Dwight Schultz.
The Rabbit Who Ate Las Vegas. The kidnapping of a gambler leads to a mobster (Charles Cioffi) and then to a $100,000 price on Hannibal's head.
The Out-of-Towners. The team aids Manhattan shopkeepers victimized by mobsters extorting protection money; guest Yaphet Kotto.
Holiday in the Hills. Fanatical mountain men attack after the team crash-lands deep in the Appalachians; guests Edward Winter, Bill McKinney.
West Coast Turnaround. A rancher (Stuart Whitman) tries to ruin a Vietnam veteran's (Robert Sampson) struggling farm; guest Tim Rossovich.
Married. Banner finds love with a psychiatrist (Mariette Hartley) with a problem of her own.
